verdict.rationale:
Fathom docs mention admin-configurable view permissions for shared meetings and a dedicated users/permissions API endpoint, plus folders as an organizational feature, suggesting some admin control over sharing. However there's no evidence of private-by-default notes, granular link-level or workspace-level permission settings, or a dedicated admin dashboard for visibility into what's shared.

missing for 10: private-by-default note settings, granular link-sharing permissions, workspace-level permission tiers, an admin audit/visibility dashboard for shared content.
